The `_openProjectFileManager` method opens it via `showModalBottomSheet`. The project chat input is in `_buildProjectChatView` — a plain `TextField` using `_chatInputCtl` with no file-link/attachment button nearby (only an image/video button for vision). No `_FileViewer` or `_buildFileView` widget exists anywhere. `BridgeMessage` is defined in `project_bridge_service.dart` with an `isFiles` getter and a `files` field of type `List<ProjectFileNode>`.

---

### EVIDENCE

- **`C:\Users\user\Desktop\weather\mobile_app\lib\main.dart:2878-2995`** — Full `_ProjectFileBrowser` class (lines approximate, since the file is very long and line numbers were not shown in the output). The class is a `StatelessWidget` with constructor parameters: `project` (ProjectContact), `files` (List<ProjectFileNode>), `currentPath` (String), `onNavigate`, `onRefresh`, `onLinkToChat`, `onOpenFile`. It renders: a header row with project name + current path + up/refresh/close buttons, then either a `CircularProgressIndicator` (when `files` is empty) or a `ListView.builder` of `_FileNodeTile` widgets, all wrapped in `DraggableScrollableSheet` (initial 75%, min 40%, max 95%).

- **`C:\Users\user\Desktop\weather\mobile_app\lib\main.dart:2011-2062`** — `_openProjectFileManager` method. It first resets `_projectFiles` and `_projectFileTreePath`, calls `_projectBridge?.requestFileTree()`, adds a status message, then calls `showModalBottomSheet<void>(context: context, isScrollControlled: true, showDragHandle: true, builder: ...)`. Inside the builder it uses `StatefulBuilder` wrapping `_ProjectFileBrowser(...)`. The `.then(...)` callback is empty.

- **`C:\Users\user\Desktop\weather\mobile_app\lib\main.dart:1708-1850`** — The `_buildProjectChatView` method. The chat input area is at lines 1827-1848: a `Row` with an `IconButton` (tooltip: 'Фото в vision', icon: `Icons.image_outlined`, calls `_sendProjectPhotos`), an `Expanded` containing `TextField` bound to `_chatInputCtl` (hintText: 'Сообщение', `onSubmitted: (_) => _sendProjectMessage()`), and a send `IconButton.filled`. **There is no button to insert a file link into the text input.** The only attachment-adjacent button is the image/vision button.

- **`C:\Users\user\Desktop\weather\mobile_app\lib\main.dart:228`** — `_chatInputCtl` is declared as `final TextEditingController _chatInputCtl = TextEditingController();` in `_HomePageState`. It is reused for both regular chat (line ~1520 area) and project chat (line ~1830 area). The `_openAttachMenu` (line ~1411) serves only the regular messenger (gallery/camera/sticker).

- **No matches for `_FileViewer`, `_buildFileView`, `FilePreview`, `FileViewer`** across all 65 `.dart` files in the project.

- **`C:\Users\user\Desktop\weather\mobile_app\lib\services\project_bridge_service.dart:12-66`** — `BridgeMessage` class definition. Constructor fields: `type`, `text`, `tuiRunning`, `projectId`, `sessionId`, `projects`, `messages`, `imageBase64`, `imageMimeType`, `imageFilename`, `files` (type `List<ProjectFileNode>`, default `const []`). Has getters: `isImage`, `isOutput`, `isStatus`, `isError`, `isSent`, `isPong`, `isProjects`, `isHistory`, `isSessionInfo`, `isFiles` (returns `type == 'files'`). Factory `BridgeMessage.fromJson` parses the `files` field from JSON as `ProjectFileNode.fromJson`.

- **`C:\Users\user\Desktop\weather\mobile_app\lib\models\project_file.dart:1-56`** — `ProjectFileNode` model with fields: `name`, `path`, `isDir`, `size`, `children` (recursive), plus factory `fromJson`, `toJson`, `sizeLabel` getter, and `sorted` static method.

---

### CHANGES

None.

---

### RISKS

- The `_openProjectFileManager` method resets `_projectFiles` and sets state on `this` widget (not the sheet's `StatefulBuilder`), then opens the sheet. If `_projectFiles` updates arrive after the sheet is already open, the `_ProjectFileBrowser` inside the sheet receives the updated list via the closure over `_projectFiles`. This works but is fragile — the sheet's `setSheetState` is not called on new file data arrival, so the sheet only visually updates if the parent `setState` triggers a rebuild of the sheet's builder. Currently the `onMessage` callback in `_openProjectContact` does call `setState` on `_HomePageState`, which should cascade. But there is no explicit `setSheetState` call for file updates, which could cause stale UI.

- The project chat input uses `_chatInputCtl` which is **shared** between regular messenger and project views. When switching between them, the text is not cleared, which could be confusing.
